# Script to BLAST S_tort genes against Arabidopsis and bring in annotation

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(rtracklayer)
```

I use blastn since these are both Brassicaceae

## make the BLAST database
If you needed to make a BLAST database...
```bash
cd /analyzed_data/ref_genomes/A_thaliana

makeblastdb -in TAIR10_cds_20110103_representative_gene_model_updated.fa -dbtype nucl
```

## Run BLAST
```bash
cd /analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/
mkdir -p blast_results

cd /analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/blast_results

blastn -query ../S_tort_YO1_2_1.HAP1.transcripts.fasta \
  -db /analyzed_data/ref_genomes/A_thaliana/TAIR10_cds_20110103_representative_gene_model_updated.fa \
  -strand both \
  -task dc-megablast \
  -outfmt 10 \
  -culling_limit 1 \
  -max_hsps 1 \
  -evalue 10e-4 \
  -num_threads 6 \
  -template_type coding \
  -template_length 16 \
  -out S_tort_YO1_2_1.HAP1_vs_At_dc-megablast_out.csv

  head S_tort_YO1_2_1.HAP1_vs_At_dc-megablast_out.csv
```


## Now bring into R for filtering, formatting, etc

Import results
```{r}
s_tort_blast <- read_csv("/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/blast_results/S_tort_YO1_2_1.HAP1_vs_At_dc-megablast_out.csv", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(s_tort_blast) <- c("query","subject","perc_ID","aln_length","mismatch","gap_open","qstart","qend","sstart","send","eval","score")
head(s_tort_blast)
summary(s_tort_blast)
```

Compare hits vs queries
```{r, engine='bash'}
cd /analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/
grep -c ">" S_tort_YO1_2_1.HAP1.transcripts.fasta # total number of query sequences
```
29159 sequences in query

```{r}
s_tort_blast %>% pull(query) %>% unique %>% length # total number queries with a hit
```

28079 of 29159 queries had a hit.

filter to retain best hit
```{r}
s_tort_blast_best <- s_tort_blast %>% group_by(query) %>% filter(score==max(score))
s_tort_blast_best
s_tort_blast_best %>% pull(query) %>% duplicated %>% sum
duplicates <- s_tort_blast_best %>% pull(query) %>% .[duplicated(.)]
s_tort_blast_best %>% filter(query %in% duplicates)
s_tort_blast_best <- s_tort_blast_best %>% group_by(query) %>%
  filter(perc_ID==max(perc_ID)) %>% #for queries with multiple best hits based on score, keep the one with higher perc_ID (which will also have shorter alignment length if it has the same score)
  filter(row_number()==1) # and finally just choose the first one if anything is left.
s_tort_blast_best
```


Add annotations from TAIR

download from https://www.arabidopsis.org/download/index-auto.jsp?dir=/download_files/Subscriber_Data_Releases

```{r}
atDesc <- read_tsv("/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/Araport11_functional_descriptions_20260930.txt.gz") %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "\\..*$")) %>%
  rename_all(\(x)(str_c("At_", x))) %>%
    filter(!duplicated(At_name)) #not ideal
atDesc
```

```{r}
atSymbol <- read_tsv("/analyzed_data/GWAS_workshop/data/gene_aliases_20260930.txt.gz") %>%
    rename_all(\(x) (str_c("At_", x))) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(At_locus_name)) #not ideal
atSymbol
```


Add the annotation
```{r}
s_tort_blast_best <- s_tort_blast_best %>%
  mutate(AGI = str_remove(subject, "\\..*$")) %>%
  left_join(atSymbol, by = c("AGI" = "At_locus_name")) %>%
  left_join(atDesc, by = c("AGI" = "At_name"))

s_tort_blast_best
```

Now add location information


```{r}
gff <- import("/Users/jmaloof/Sequences/ref_genomes/B_rapa/genome/V3.0/Brapa_genome_v3.0_genes.gff3.gz")
gff <- gff[gff$type=="mRNA",]
gff <- as_tibble(gff) %>%
  mutate(geneID=str_extract(ID,"Bra.*$")) %>%
  dplyr::select(geneID, chrom=seqnames, start,end)
head(gff)
```


```{r}
S_tort_annotated <- s_tort_blast_best %>% left_join(gff,by = c("query" = "geneID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(name=query, chrom, start, end, subject, AGI, matches("At_"), perc_ID, aln_length, mismatch, gap_open, qstart, qend, sstart, send, eval, score) %>%
  arrange(chrom, start)
head(S_tort_annotated)
```

```{r}
write.csv(S_tort_annotated, here("output", "S_tort_YO1_2-1_Hap1_annotated.csv"))

```
